Previously the category came from the SiteSetting embed_category (removed in this diff, with its value baked into per-host records during migration). Notably, the feed-polling path (topic_retriever only validates the embed URL against hosts before calling retrieve; the feed URL itself need not match a host) can thus pass an unmatched URL to import, yielding a nil category and posts silently landing in uncategorized instead of the configured embed category. Plausible and partially verifiable from the diff, though the exact import call sites in the polling flow are not shown, so confidence is moderate.
